location: Naracoorte, Limestone Coast, South Australia, Australia

main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Rye grass on free-draining Limestone Coast loam)
main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Located in South Australia's Limestone Coast near the Western Victorian border. Features a 1,730m undulating turf oval with tight-to-medium bends and a very short 270-metre home straight. Because the home stretch is only 270m, leaders ('E') and forward box-seat pressers ('P') turning in the top three hold a commanding advantage. Deep backmarkers ('C') rarely circle the field in time unless early sectionals collapse.
main_turf.post_bias: STRONG INSIDE BARRIER ADVANTAGE: Barriers 1 through 4 hold a clear edge in 1000m, 1100m, 1200m, and 1430m events. Wide draws (8+) suffer heavy ground loss on the turns with minimal straight length (270m) to recover.

handicapping_angles.short_270m_straight_on_pace_lock: With just a 270m home straight, tactical early speed ('E' with 'is_lone_speed': true) and rail-hugging stalkers ('P') dominate across all distances (+3.5 pts pace-map upgrade). Penalize slow-breaking get-back runners ('C').
handicapping_angles.western_victorian_cross_border_shipper_e: Positioned right beside the Victorian border, Naracoorte attracts far stronger Victorian country/provincial stables shipping across from Warrnambool, Stawell, Horsham, and Ballarat (Tom Dabernig, Symon Wilde, Paul Preusker, Maddie Raymond, Lindsey Smith) alongside top SA yards (Sue & Jason Jaensch, Richard & Chantelle Jolly, Michael Hickmott). Upgrade VIC benchmark droppers (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.naracoorte_cup_showcase: The Naracoorte Cup ($40k+ Feature, 2000m, February) elevates field strength to SA Provincial / VIC Country Cup standard.
handicapping_angles.limestone_coast_circuit_translation: Form flows directly between Naracoorte, Mount Gambier, Penola, Bordertown, and Millicent. Wet winter/early-spring meetings on Soft 6 to Heavy 9 reward proven Limestone Coast mudlarks.
